IN.one_line: Buy ICICI Bank for the best risk-adjusted chance of beating the market.
reasons: This bank has grown faster than the market over the past year.
It is less jumpy than the other choices.
There is no company results date before the end of next month.
good_news: The latest earnings were 4.6% above estimates.
Six whole shares fit within the ₹10,000 budget.
bad_news: The bank is near its 52-week high.
The market has already risen 5.83% this month.
A short holding period can be dominated by random price moves.

US.one_line: Pick Newell cautiously: improving sales offer an edge, but debt and volatility threaten it.
reasons: Newell could beat the wider market as shoppers keep buying household goods.
Its sales grew, and many shares traded during the price rise.
It still loses money and owes substantial debt, so this is uncertain.
good_news: Trading volume reached 2.78 times its recent average.
bad_news: The latest quarter recorded a net loss.
The price already jumped 15.06% in a day.
Heavy debt and sharp price swings increase the risk.
